articles.author: Mariapaula Gonzalez, Rebecca Ungarino
articles.title: Bank of America CEO Sparks Bank Stock Selloff With One Small Word - Barron's
articles.description: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said at a conference on Monday that sales and trading revenue for the fiscal third quarter will be “flat.”
articles.content:
Shares ofBank of Americaturned sharply lower on Monday after the banks chief executive, Brian Moynihan, said quarterly sales and trading revenue would be flat relative to a year ago.
